Am plecat din industria care contine oaspetii si am ajuns in cea care contine piesele, si n-as schimba nimic din aceasta trecere. Cel mai mult ma multumesc ca pot sa vad, dupa douazeci de ani, ca oamenii care au intrat cu mine in primafabrica au crescut ei insisi.
Coordonarea imbunatatirii proceselor pe doua linii de asamblare si pe statia de vopsire.
Managementul proiectelor de investitie in zona de productie, de la fezabilitate la punere in functiune.
Coordonarea cu productie, calitate, mentenanta, logistica si achizitii in proiectele de schimbare.
Dezvoltarea si mentinerea indicatorilor de performanta ai proceselor.
Am condus doua proiecte de transfer de productie catre un partener din Republica Ceha, cu standarde de calitate diferite si termene stranse.
Am lucrat cu un furnizor german de componente, ceea ce m-a invatat cat de mult conteaza claritatea in specificatii.
Am mentinut doua linii in operatiune pe perioada transferului, fara impact asupra livrarilor.
Un indicator pe care nu il urmaresti niciodata este doar un numar intr-un raport.
Am inteles ca un indicator trebuie sa declanseze o actiune, altfel nu este un indicator, este o decoratiune.
Masur de preferinta timpul de ciclu, rata de defecte si timpul de oprire neplanificat, ca le pot lega de actiuni concrete.

work_description: Resolution d'incidents complexes sur une plateforme de gestion documentaire.
Analyse de causes racines et escalation vers l'equipe produit.
Formation des utilisateurs et documentation de resolution.
Support de premier niveau pour des clients du secteur financier.
Mise en place d'une base de connaissances qui a reduit les tickets recurrents.
Premiere experience IT: gestion des acces et support utilisateur interne.

items: Escalade N3 (2023): rezolvarea incidentelor recurente care blocau clientii mari.

Formation (2022): sesiuni de onboarding pentru utilizatori noi, in romana si in franceza.
J'explique toujours en termes metier, pas en capture d'ecran technique.
Je ne ferme jamais un ticket sans une etape de verification.
Je prefere dire a l'equipe produit ce qui est Cassé plutot que de le laisser decouvrir.
J'ecris les procedures pour que mon collegue puisse les appliquer pendant que je suis en conge.
La discipline du service client est stricta: un delai de reponse est une promesse professionnelle.
Le fait de travailler dans une langue seconde m'a appris a ecrire plus clairement.
La proximite avec l'equipe produit m'a montre qu'un bon support anticipe au lieu d'attendre.

Mon parcours est long et irregulier; la reconversion tardive a des consequences sur les salaires, et je les assume.

Le support technique est souvent le point de contact le plus visible d'une entreprise, et c'est aussi celui que les gens oublient. Formation continue en gestion de service et en communication de crise.
Participation a deux conferences de support technique, en France et en Roumanie.

raw_cv.summary: Inginer RF si planificare radio cu 12 ani in telecomunicatii: GSM/UMTS/LTE si migrari 5G, plus linkuri microwave de capacitate. Am lucrat atat pentru operator, cat si pentru integrator, deci stiu cum se traduc cerintele de retea in decizii de RF. Sunt atent la bugete si la termene, pentru ca in turnouts radio nimeni nu asteapta.

work_description: Planificare radio LTE si 5G NR, inclusiv refarm si modernizare.
Masuratori pe teren, ajustare de parametri si optimizare a acoperirii.
Validare cu drivere si benchmark-uri in zone urbane si rurale.
Proiectare si implementare de retele de acces radio si microwave.
Lucrari de turn si masuratori de teren in conditii grele.
Mentenanta de statii de baza si depanare de retea.

certifications: Curs de teoria propagarii radio, 3 luni (2021)

description: Planificare si validare in zona urbana densificata.
Extindere a acoperirii in zone rurale, cu analize de propagare.
Proiectare a unui nod de transport pe ruta nationala.
Zona rurala cu relief accidentat si un operator care cerea acoperire pe sosea, fara sa justifice economic un site nou.
Am analizat profilul de teren, am propus doua solutii de infrastructura care sa serveasca si transportul de fibra, si am avut nevoie de intalnirile cu autoritatile locale.
Nu am fost doar planificator radio acolo, ci si un partener de negociere.

items: Verific pe teren ce arata modelul, pentru ca terenul are mereu ultima cuvanta.
Tin cont de bugetul de la inceput; o solutie care nu incape in buget nu e o solutie.
Documentez masuratorile, pentru ca orice revizie ulterioara sa poata fi inteleasa.
Lucrez bine cu echipele de teren, care imi spun mereu ca modelul greseste.
Anul 2015 a fost unul dintre cei mai grei: migrari cu mentenante de noapte si termene stranse.
Am invatat ca decizia de a renunta la un target de acoperire cere mai mult curaj decat decizia de a-l promite.
Am gestionat si o relatie contractuala tensionata cu un furnizor, ceea ce m-a invatat sa fiu ferm fara sa fiu rigid.

In telecom, cifrele sunt realul, nu impresiile: daca acoperirea nu e acolo, niciun tabel frumos nu conteaza. Am ales sa raman in zona tehnica a retelei pentru ca vreau sa vad efectul real al deciziilor mele pe teren.
Dimineata: rapoarte de acoperire de noapte si evenimente din reteaua nationala.
Ziua: planificare, simulari de acoperire si discunii cu echipele de teren.
Seara: rapoarte de masuratoare si planificarea intervenniilor saptamanale.
Faptul ca o decizie de planificare se vede la cateva luni dupa, pe teren, in realitate.
Masuratorile, care nu mint si nu au interese, oricat de complicat ar fi un model.
Oamenii din teren, care au o intelegere a retelei pe care nicio documentatie nu o prinde.
O masuratoare facuta gresit este mai periculoasa decat una nefacuta, pentru ca se bazeaza pe ea decizii de milioane.
Repetarea masuratorilor in conditii diferite este singura modalitate de a sti ca ai masurat bine.
Nu public niciodata o masuratoare fara contextul meteorologic si fara pozitia exacta a punctului.

economic un site nou. Am analizat profilul de teren, am propus doua solutii de infrastructura care sa
serveasca si transportul de fibra, si am avut nevoie de intalnirile cu autoritatile locale. Nu am fost doar
planificator radio acolo, ci si un partener de negociere, iar asta face parte din meserie.

de milioane.

Bucharest
Nicolae Ardelean
+40 722 663 118
nicolae.ardelean.cv@gmail.com
Computer Vision / ML Engineer - robotics & inspection - 9 years
linkedin.com/in/nicolae-ardelean-cv
PROFILE
Machine learning engineer working on computer vision for industrial inspection and robotics, 9 years of which
four in industrial research. I have taken models from a notebook on a laptop to a line that runs at 20 frames
per second with a camera bolted above a conveyor. My bias is toward systems that work on the factory floor,
not benchmarks that work on a conference slide.
EXPERIENCE
Senior ML Engineer 2019 - Present
Robotics company - Bucharest
(cid:127) Defect detection on production lines using deep learning on industrial images.
(cid:127) Deployed models on edge hardware with a hard real-time budget.
(cid:127) Built the data collection and labelling pipeline with plant operators.
(cid:127) Wrote the monitoring that catches model drift before it reaches the customer.
ML Engineer 2016 - 2019
Automotive supplier - Bucharest
(cid:127) Stereo vision and 3D reconstruction for a quality control cell.
(cid:127) Trained and deployed models on a limited GPU budget.
(cid:127) Coordinated datasets with the customer, including transfer of IP.
Research Engineer 2013 - 2016
Institute for AI research - Bucharest
(cid:127) Publications in image segmentation and object detection.
(cid:127) Teaching assistantship for the computer vision course.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, ONNX/TensorRT
Tasks: detection, segmentation, 3D vision, optical flow, calibration
Engineering: Python, C++, CUDA basics, Docker, data pipelines
Deployment: edge devices, real-time constraints, monitoring and drift
SELECTED PROJECTS
(cid:127) Surface defect detection running at line speed, with a false-accept rate below the manual inspection
baseline.


(cid:127) Active learning workflow that cut annotation cost by roughly two thirds.
(cid:127) Stereo calibration and depth pipeline for robotic picking, replacing a mechanical fixture.
(cid:127) On-device optimisation that brought inference under the frame budget without a custom accelerator.
PUBLICATIONS
(cid:127) Sparse depth estimation for structured scenes (co-authored, 2015).
(cid:127) Efficient annotation pipelines for industrial defect datasets (co-authored, 2018).
(cid:127) Two workshop papers on domain shift in manufacturing imagery.
EDUCATION
PhD Computer Science, University of Bucharest (2016). M.Sc. Computer Vision. Romanian native, English
C1, Italian B1.
WHAT I AM GOOD AND LESS GOOD AT
I am strong on the awkward middle of applied machine learning: collecting the data, making the model fast
enough, and keeping it honest once it is in production. I am less deep than a researcher on new architectures,
and I have no appetite for spending a year on a benchmark that nobody will deploy.
HOW I WORK
(cid:127) Data before models: a week on the data is worth a month on the architecture.
(cid:127) Production first: I design for the camera, the lighting and the line speed I actually have.
(cid:127) Measure on the plant floor: offline accuracy means little if the line rejects good parts.
(cid:127) Leave a trail: every model ships with its data version, its metrics and its limits documented.
(cid:127) Talk to operators: they see the failure modes the dataset never had.
ENGINEERING REALITIES
(cid:127) Latency budget: the camera, the capture and the inference had to fit a fixed frame time, so we planned
from the budget backwards.
(cid:127) Edge deployment: ran on industrial hardware without a GPU, which forced simpler models and better
engineering.
(cid:127) Data pipeline: operators capture and label during breaks in production, so the dataset matches reality.
(cid:127) Monitoring: drift is detected on the plant floor and reported to the plant, not to a dashboard nobody opens.
COLLABORATIONS
(cid:127) With plant quality engineers, to define what counts as a defect and what the plant can accept.
(cid:127) With the camera and optics supplier, on lighting and lens choices that made the problem simpler.


(cid:127) With the customer quality department, on the evidence trail the plant needs to keep.
TEACHING AND MENTORING
(cid:127) I have mentored four junior engineers, two of whom now lead their own projects.
(cid:127) I run a weekly reading group on papers from industry, not only from conferences.
(cid:127) I teach a course module on applied computer vision for masters students.
(cid:127) I co-supervise one PhD student on industrial anomaly detection.
TOOLS
(cid:127) PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, ONNX and TensorRT.
(cid:127) Python, C++ and some CUDA for custom operations when the profiler says so.
(cid:127) Git, DVC, Docker, and a simple job scheduler I wrote myself.
(cid:127) A spreadsheet that lists every failure mode the plant has ever reported.
INTERESTS
(cid:127) Restoring old measuring instruments, which has taught me a lot about error sources.
(cid:127) Analogue photography, mostly for the same reason I like imaging: the physics of it.
(cid:127) Mountain hiking, slowly and without ambition for speed.
A NOTE ON WEAKNESSES
I am an applied engineer who happens to be good at modelling, not a researcher chasing new architectures. I
am less comfortable with pure theory than my publication record might suggest, and I am slowest in the parts
of the job that need many meetings: aligning people and papers, and selling a timeline internally.
PROIECTE ACADEMICE SI COLABORARI
(cid:127) Doun proiecte finantate in domeniul vederii industriale, cu parteneri din industrie.
(cid:127) Cinci ani de activitate publicistica, cu doua reviste si doua conferinte de profil.
(cid:127) Coordonarea a doua proiecte de licenta si a unui stagiu de cercetare in strainatate.
CE AM SCHIMBAT IN ABORDARE
(cid:127) In 2018 am renuntat la un model cu acuracies ridicata in laborator, pentru ca in teren pierdea din cauza
luminii, si am reconstruit intreaga solutie in jurul camerei si a iluminarii.
(cid:127) Am invatat sa implic producatorul de la definirea problemei, nu doar la testarea solutiei.
(cid:127) Am inteles ca cel mai greu nu este modelul, ci mentinerea lui corect in timp.
RESPONSABILITATI ACTUALE

(cid:127) Coordonarea echipei de ingineri de date si viziune, cinci persoane.

(cid:127) Prezentarea rezultatelor catre clientii industriali si in consiliile de management.

(cid:127) Proiecte cu volum mare de date si cu bugete pentru echipe serioase.

Bucharest
[CANDIDATE_NAME]
[REDACTED_PHONE]
[REDACTED_EMAIL]
Computer Vision / ML Engineer - robotics & inspection - 9 years
[REDACTED_URL]
PROFILE
Machine learning engineer working on computer vision for industrial inspection and robotics, 9 years of which
four in industrial research. I have taken models from a notebook on a laptop to a line that runs at 20 frames
per second with a camera bolted above a conveyor. My bias is toward systems that work on the factory floor,
not benchmarks that work on a conference slide.
EXPERIENCE
Senior ML Engineer 2019 - Present
Robotics company - Bucharest
(cid:127) Defect detection on production lines using deep learning on industrial images.
(cid:127) Deployed models on edge hardware with a hard real-time budget.
(cid:127) Built the data collection and labelling pipeline with plant operators.
(cid:127) Wrote the monitoring that catches model drift before it reaches the customer.
ML Engineer 2016 - 2019
Automotive supplier - Bucharest
(cid:127) Stereo vision and 3D reconstruction for a quality control cell.
(cid:127) Trained and deployed models on a limited GPU budget.
(cid:127) Coordinated datasets with the customer, including transfer of IP.
Research Engineer 2013 - 2016
Institute for AI research - Bucharest
(cid:127) Publications in image segmentation and object detection.
(cid:127) Teaching assistantship for the computer vision course.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, ONNX/TensorRT
Tasks: detection, segmentation, 3D vision, optical flow, calibration
Engineering: Python, C++, CUDA basics, Docker, data pipelines
Deployment: edge devices, real-time constraints, monitoring and drift
SELECTED PROJECTS
(cid:127) Surface defect detection running at line speed, with a false-accept rate below the manual inspection
baseline.


(cid:127) Active learning workflow that cut annotation cost by roughly two thirds.
(cid:127) Stereo calibration and depth pipeline for robotic picking, replacing a mechanical fixture.
(cid:127) On-device optimisation that brought inference under the frame budget without a custom accelerator.
PUBLICATIONS
(cid:127) Sparse depth estimation for structured scenes (co-authored, 2015).
(cid:127) Efficient annotation pipelines for industrial defect datasets (co-authored, 2018).
(cid:127) Two workshop papers on domain shift in manufacturing imagery.
EDUCATION
PhD Computer Science, University of Bucharest (2016). M.Sc. Computer Vision. Romanian native, English
C1, Italian B1.
WHAT I AM GOOD AND LESS GOOD AT
I am strong on the awkward middle of applied machine learning: collecting the data, making the model fast
enough, and keeping it honest once it is in production. I am less deep than a researcher on new architectures,
and I have no appetite for spending a year on a benchmark that nobody will deploy.
HOW I WORK
(cid:127) Data before models: a week on the data is worth a month on the architecture.
(cid:127) Production first: I design for the camera, the lighting and the line speed I actually have.
(cid:127) Measure on the plant floor: offline accuracy means little if the line rejects good parts.
(cid:127) Leave a trail: every model ships with its data version, its metrics and its limits documented.
(cid:127) Talk to operators: they see the failure modes the dataset never had.
ENGINEERING REALITIES
(cid:127) Latency budget: the camera, the capture and the inference had to fit a fixed frame time, so we planned
from the budget backwards.
(cid:127) Edge deployment: ran on industrial hardware without a GPU, which forced simpler models and better
engineering.
(cid:127) Data pipeline: operators capture and label during breaks in production, so the dataset matches reality.
(cid:127) Monitoring: drift is detected on the plant floor and reported to the plant, not to a dashboard nobody opens.
COLLABORATIONS
(cid:127) With plant quality engineers, to define what counts as a defect and what the plant can accept.
(cid:127) With the camera and optics supplier, on lighting and lens choices that made the problem simpler.


(cid:127) With the customer quality department, on the evidence trail the plant needs to keep.
TEACHING AND MENTORING
(cid:127) I have mentored four junior engineers, two of whom now lead their own projects.
(cid:127) I run a weekly reading group on papers from industry, not only from conferences.
(cid:127) I teach a course module on applied computer vision for masters students.
(cid:127) I co-supervise one PhD student on industrial anomaly detection.
TOOLS
(cid:127) PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, ONNX and TensorRT.
(cid:127) Python, C++ and some CUDA for custom operations when the profiler says so.
(cid:127) Git, DVC, Docker, and a simple job scheduler I wrote myself.
(cid:127) A spreadsheet that lists every failure mode the plant has ever reported.
INTERESTS
(cid:127) Restoring old measuring instruments, which has taught me a lot about error sources.
(cid:127) Analogue photography, mostly for the same reason I like imaging: the physics of it.
(cid:127) Mountain hiking, slowly and without ambition for speed.
A NOTE ON WEAKNESSES
I am an applied engineer who happens to be good at modelling, not a researcher chasing new architectures. I
am less comfortable with pure theory than my publication record might suggest, and I am slowest in the parts
of the job that need many meetings: aligning people and papers, and selling a timeline internally.

(cid:127) Doun proiecte finantate in domeniul vederii industriale, cu parteneri din industrie.
(cid:127) Cinci ani de activitate publicistica, cu doua reviste si doua conferinte de profil.
(cid:127) Coordonarea a doua proiecte de licenta si a unui stagiu de cercetare in strainatate.
CE AM SCHIMBAT IN ABORDARE
(cid:127) In 2018 am renuntat la un model cu acuracies ridicata in laborator, pentru ca in teren pierdea din cauza
luminii, si am reconstruit intreaga solutie in jurul camerei si a iluminarii.
(cid:127) Am invatat sa implic producatorul de la definirea problemei, nu doar la testarea solutiei.
(cid:127) Am inteles ca cel mai greu nu este modelul, ci mentinerea lui corect in timp.

(cid:127) Coordonarea echipei de ingineri de date si viziune, cinci persoane.

raw_cv.summary: Industrial ERP and MES architect with 11 years digitalising factories: production planning, shop‑floor data, traceability and cost. I have seen plenty of ERP projects that failed because nobody modelled the plant correctly, so I insist on spending time on the floor before I touch a blueprint. I am a functional architect with strong domain knowledge and light coding ability.

work_description: Designed the target operating model for plants running on ERP.
Specified shop‑floor data collection and integrated the MES with finance and logistics.
Led the discovery workshops that replaced legacy spreadsheets with real traceability.
Governance of the master data model across six plants.
Implementation projects in discrete manufacturing, from blueprint to go-live.
Process mapping in the plant, not only in the office.
Planning and scheduling; the years that taught me how factories really work.

description: model comun de date si trasabilitate, cu implementare pe doua etape.
model de cost care a scos la iveala un consum ascuns intr-o zona de productie.
repozitionarea planului de productie intre cerere si capacitate reala.

In 2020, a component factory produced a monthly cost report that did not match reality, with differences reaching hundreds of thousands of lei. Discovered that three different nomenclators were used for the same part type, causing cost allocation based on code rather than real consumption. Refactored the data model to a single nomenclator with governance rules, resulting in a reliable report. Demonstrated that ERP problems are often data and process issues rather than configuration.

items: Petrec timp in fabrica inainte sa scriu blueprint-ul; nu proiectez procese pe care nu le-am vazut.
Construiesc modelul de date de la gol, ca sa nu mostenesc erorile sistemului vechi.
Tin principiul guvernantei: cine introduce o regula, raspunde de actualizarea ei.
Pregatesc echipele clientului, pentru ca sistemul sa nu depinda de mine.
Am lucrat cinci ani in planificare si am vazut cum se stricau programele prin decizii luate fara date.
De acolo vine obiceiul meu de a pune intrebari despre date, inainte de a discuta despre solutii.
Am ramas in industrie pentru ca exista o diferenta intre un ERP care functioneaza si unul pe care nimeni nu-l foloseste.
Nu scriu SQL de productie si nici nu vreau; asa am ales sa lucrez cu echipe tehnice.
La implementari foarte mici, costul meu de arhitect este prea mare, si o spun desi se poate auzi ca un dezavantaj.
Am fost mai rigida decat era necesar cu termenele de livrare in primii ani.
Cel mai mult ma multumesc de proiectele in care am reusit sa conving o fabrica sa isi schimbe modul de a gandi despre date, nu doar sa primeasca un sistem nou.
In fabrici, un plan de productie bun este un document care se poate executa si de catre altcineva.
Datele de shop floor sunt cel mai valoroase lucru dintr-o fabrica si cel mai prost stratite, daca nu se strange corect.
Un ERP bine configurat reduce timpul de decizie al oamenilor, si asta este un beneficiu mult mai mare decat un raport.
Ateliere de descoperire cu oamenii din fabrica, nu doar cu managerii.
Specificatii scrise pentru implementator, cu criterii de acceptare clare.
Urmarire dupa punere in functiune, cu raport lunar asupra indicatorilor agreati.

description: model comun de date si trasabilitate, cu implementare pe doua etape.
model de cost care a scos la iveala un consum ascuns intr-o zona de productie.
repozitionarea planului de productie intre cerere si capacitate reala.

In 2020, a component factory produced a monthly cost report that did not match reality, with differences reaching hundreds of thousands of lei. Discovered that three different nomenclators were used for the same part type, causing cost allocation based on code rather than real consumption. Refactored the data model to a single nomenclator with governance rules, resulting in a reliable report. Demonstrated that ERP problems are often data and process issues rather than configuration.

(cid:127) Nu scriu SQL de productie si nici nu vreau; asa am ales sa lucrez cu echipe tehnice.

(cid:127) Am fost mai rigida decat era necesar cu termenele de livrare in primii ani.

Cel mai mult ma multumesc de proiectele in care am reusit sa conving o fabrica sa isi schimbe modul de a
gandi despre date, nu doar sa primeasca un sistem nou.

items: Test intern pentru banca (2024): test complet al retelei interne, cu scenarii de miscare laterala si exfiltratie.

custom_sections.section_title: Ce Am Invatat Din Partea Defensiva
items: Am fost administrator de retea si asta ma ajuta: stiu ce Sisteme exista, cum sunt configurate si ce fac oamenii cand se panicheaza.
Cand gasesc o problema, ma intreb mereu cum a ajuns echipa acolo, pentru ca acolo este raspunsul real.
Am invatat ca cel mai bun raport este cel care este citit si aplicat, nu cel mai spectaculos.
Nu fac atacuri de aplicatii web foarte avansate de tip chaining modern; apelez specialisti pentru asta.
Nu am experienta red team cu social engineering la scara mare, desi am facut asta de mai multe ori in medii controlate.
Lucrez numai cu autorizare scrisa si in limite clare, fara exceptii.

Le vrai enthousiasme pour mon metier vient du moment ou une equipe realise qu'une vulnerabilite pouvait etre corrigee en une heure et qu'elle ne l'a etait pas. C'est ce gap que je travaille a fermer, et c'est aussi ce qui me plait dans ce metier plus que le technique pure.
Un compte de service avec des droits trop larges, qui n'apparaissait dans aucune revue d'acces.
Un bucket de stockage accessible publiquement, avec des donnees clients, referencie par une URL devinee.
Un workflow de validation des modifications qui pouvait ete contourne par une requete envoyee directement a l'API.

Dr. Ana Petrescu, MD, PhD
Consultant General Surgeon (Medic Primar) - Laparoscopic & Oncologic Surgery
Cluj-Napoca | +40 741 336 782 | dr.ana.petrescu@gmail.com
PROFESSIONAL PROFILE
General surgeon with 13 years post-graduation, now Medic Primar at Spitalul Clinic Judetean de Urgenta Cluj, Surgery III.
Focus: laparoscopic colorectal and upper-GI surgery, emergency surgery, surgical oncology (HIPEC team member). Operate
220-260 cases/year as primary surgeon; conversion rate under 4%, anastomotic-leak rate within benchmark. PhD on enhanced
recovery (ERAS) in colorectal surgery (2021). Teach 5th-year students and 6 residents; calm, checklist-driven, family-centred
communication.
MEDICAL TRAINING (TIMELINE)
2019-2020 Fellowship: Minimally Invasive & Oncologic Surgery - Centre Leon Berard / Hopital Edouard Herriot, Lyon,
France (12 months, Prof. Perdrix team). 180 cases as first assistant/primary under supervision.
2013-2018 Residency: General Surgery - UMF Cluj + SCJU Cluj (6 years). Board exam 10/10 (2018). Rotations:
emergency, ICU (4 months), vascular (3 months).
2007-2013 MD, General Medicine - UMF Iuliu Hatieganu Cluj, valedictorian track (9.6/10). Thesis: sepsis biomarkers.
2021 PhD Medical Sciences - UMF Cluj. Thesis: ERAS protocols in laparoscopic colectomy; 2 ISI papers.
CLINICAL EXPERIENCE
Medic Primar, Surgery III (laparoscopic & oncology) Jan 2023 - Present
Spitalul Clinic Judetean de Urgenta Cluj
(cid:127) Primary surgeon for 240 cases/year: colectomies (60% laparoscopic), gastrectomies, low anterior resections, emergency
laparotomies.
(cid:127) HIPEC team member (12 procedures/year); ERAS lead for ward: LOS 9.2 to 6.8 days, complications -22%.
(cid:127) Night/weekend emergency rota 1:5; damage-control decisions with ICU and radiology.
(cid:127) Supervise 6 residents; weekly skills lab (suturing, staplers, energy devices).
Medic Specialist 2018 - 2022
Spitalul Clinic Judetean de Urgenta Cluj
(cid:127) Independent elective lists (150/year) + emergency; introduced laparoscopic TAPP for inguinal hernias (120 cases).
(cid:127) Morbidity-mortality presenter; audit of 400 cholecystectomies (bile-duct injury 0.25%).
Resident 2013 - 2018
SCJU Cluj + rotations (Dej, Turda)
(cid:127) 4,000+ assisted hours; graduated with 320 primary-surgeon cases logged (appendectomies, hernias, stomas).

raw_cv.summary: R&D manager and power-electronics specialist with 18 years in automotive inverters and battery management. Currently R&D Manager at Continental, Timisoara: lead 22 engineers (hardware + firmware + validation) on 800V SiC traction inverters for 2 OEM platforms; efficiency 98.2%, SOP 2025 with zero late gates. Hold 8 granted patents (thermal + gate-drive) and 14 papers. Bridge lab-to-factory: DFM with plants in Timisoara and Nuremberg, ASPICE SWE.3, ISO 26262 ASIL-C.

work_description: Lead department of 22 (4 team leads): hardware, embedded C, HIL validation; budget EUR 3.5M/year.
Delivered 2 inverter generations (150-250 kW, SiC): double-pulse characterisation, EMC pre-compliance first pass, efficiency +1.4pp vs target.
Own ASPICE L2 assessments; traceability with Codebeamer; audits passed with 0 major findings 3 years running.
Transfer to series production: yield 99.2% at 50k units/year; 8D closures with 3 semiconductor suppliers.
Hired and grew 12 engineers from graduates; 2 became team leads; attrition under 8%.
Designed DC/DC and BMS slaves (48V): schematics in Altium, thermal sim in FloTHERM, DV testing.
Cut field returns 40% via derating + conformal-coating process change.
PhD on soft-switching converters; lab prototypes to 3 kW; supervised 30+ diploma projects.
Testing and repair benches; learned magnetics hands-on.

education.thesis_title: Soft-switching converters

description: 250 kW peak, 98.2% CEC efficiency; double-pulse characterisation of 3 SiC vendors, winner selected on switching loss + short-circuit ruggedness.

Functional safety to ASIL-C: FMEDA with 400+ failure modes, freedom-from-interference argued for dual-core lockstep.

3.3 kW LLC prototype at 94.5% peak; published control-tuning method still used in UPT lab course.
dSPACE-based rig with fault injection (open/short on 40 channels); regression time 3 days to overnight; adopted by 3 teams.

(cid:127) Testare automata cu HIL si instrumente de laborator.

simptomul.

raw_cv.summary: Senior data scientist with 11 years turning data into decisions, mostly forecasting, experimentation and causal inference. I care about whether a model changes a decision, not whether it wins a leaderboard. I have led small teams, mentored juniors, and I am comfortable saying that a simple method often beats an elaborate one.

work_description: Demand forecasting and inventory optimisation used in daily planning.
Designed and analysed experiments and quasi-experiments.
Led a small data science team and set modelling standards.
Churn modelling, segmentation and pricing analyses.
Built the first production scoring models for the marketing team.
Statistical analyses and reporting for clients.

description: Context: planning was guesswork, causing both stockouts and excess inventory.
What I did: built demand forecasting with honest evaluation and simple, trusted models.
Outcome: forecasts adopted into weekly planning and ordering decisions.
Key lesson: the winning model is the one people act on, not the one that tops a table.

items: Decision first: start from the decision the model should change, not the method.
Simple when possible: a clear model people trust beats a black box.
Honest evaluation: out-of-time and causal checks, not just random splits.
Communicate: if stakeholders cannot act on it, the analysis failed.
Mentor: grow the team so quality does not depend on one person.
Forecasting: demand models used in weekly planning and ordering.
Experiments: a testing practice that stopped expensive wrong decisions.
Mentoring: junior scientists who now own their own workstreams.

I am a data scientist whose strength is analysis and decisions, not deep engineering. I write clean Python and SQL, but production platform and infra work belongs to data engineers, and I plan projects around that.
Python, R and SQL as the daily toolkit.
pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels for analysis and models.
Close work with product, finance and operations teams.
Mentoring and setting standards for the team.

Data science earns its place when it changes a decision. I spend as much time on framing the question and communicating the answer as on the modelling, because a perfect model that nobody acts on is just an expensive hobby.

I follow the causal inference and experiment literature closely and I enjoy teaching it internally more than I enjoy publishing. I want to keep building teams where honest analysis is valued over impressive-sounding complexity.

work_description: Lead technical pre-sales: discovery, solution design, demos and proposals.
Own responses to RFPs and the technical side of bids.
Translate customer needs into deliverables engineering can build.
Built and led delivery teams; moved toward customer-facing roles.
Backend and integration development.

items: Enterprise wins (2022): technical lead on bids that converted several large accounts.
Reference architecture: created a reusable design that shortened proposal cycles.
Delivery bridge: reduced post-sale surprises by involving delivery early.
Discovery: understand the business problem before proposing technology.
Design: a solution that can be delivered, not just a winning diagram.
Demo: tailored to the customer's world, not a generic feature tour.
Honesty: tell the customer what we cannot do before they discover it.
Handover: involve delivery early so there are no post-sale surprises.
Bid wins: technical lead on proposals that converted several large enterprise accounts.
Reusable designs: built reference architectures that shortened proposal cycles.
Cross-team: bridged sales and delivery to reduce mismatched expectations.
Cloud, APIs, integration and data platforms.
Enterprise domains: banking, industry and the public sector.
Proposal and RFP tools, presentation and demonstration craft.

Good pre-sales is honest engineering in front of a customer. I would rather lose a deal on a technical truth than win it and set delivery up to fail, and over eleven years that approach has earned more trust than it has cost.

On a large public-sector bid I led the solution design and the technical narrative. Working with the delivery lead early meant the proposal we sold was the one we could actually build, which is exactly why the account is still with us years later.
Write reference architectures teams reuse across deals.
Mentor junior solution consultants on honest pre-sales.
Keep a working knowledge of the tech so demos stay real.
Translate business needs into a deliverable design.

raw_cv.summary: Scientist in bioinformatics with 5 years of experience in genomic data analysis and reproducible pipeline development. Holds a PhD in computational biology and works at the intersection of research and engineering, focusing on scientific analysis rather than platform engineering.

work_description: Analiza de date de secventiere (RNA-seq, variant calling) si interpretare.
Construirea de pipeline-uri reproductibile (Nextflow, Snakemake).
Colaborare cu biologi si clinici; publicatii si rapoarte.
Cercetare in genomica; publicatii si prezentari la conferinte.

projects.project_name: Pipeline pentru analiza de expresie genica
description: Am construit un pipeline pentru analiza de expresie genica, de la date brute la rezultate interpretabile.
Am lucrat cu biologii pentru a intelege intrebarile, am automatizat pasii repetitivi si am documentat totul astfel incat analiza sa poata fi refacuta si verificata de altcineva.

publications.title: Genomica (2022): co-autor la studii pe expresie genica in enantioane clinice.
Metode (2021): contributie la un pipeline folosit de grupul de cercetare.
Conferinte: prezentari la intalniri de bioinformatica.

items: Sunt mai puternica pe partea stiintifica si de analiza decat pe inginerie de platforma. Pentru infrastructura la scara mare lucrez cu colegi de platforma.

Lucrez la granita dintre stiinta si inginerie. Imi place sa transform date biologice grele in rezultate clare, si sunt sincera cand o analiza are limite sau cand intrebarea biologica are nevoie de mai multe date.

items: Understand the block, the specification and its known weak points.

Set up regression and reporting so that the team has a baseline from week one.

Bucharest | +40 726 447 118 | cosmin.haralambie.dv@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/cosmin-haralambie-dv
PROFILE
Design verification engineer with 11 years in ASIC and SoC verification, mostly UVM and SystemVerilog on
advanced nodes. I have verified blocks that went to tape-out, and I have been the person who found the
corner case the schedule assumed was impossible. I care about coverage closure that means something, not
numbers on a slide, and I have a habit of writing reference models nobody asked for but everybody uses.
EXPERIENCE
Principal Verification Engineer 2019 - Present
Semiconductor company - Bucharest
(cid:127) Verification lead for a mixed-signal SoC block on a 7nm process.
(cid:127) Built the UVM environment from scratch: agents, scoreboards, coverage model.

Senior Verification Engineer 2016 - 2019
Fabless semiconductor - Bucharest

(cid:127) Worked with the design team on specification reviews and bug triage.
Verification Engineer 2013 - 2016
ASIC design house - Bucharest

Domain: DDR, SerDes, display pipeline, mixed-signal interfaces


SELECTED ACHIEVEMENTS
(cid:127) Caught a race condition in the arbitration logic before first silicon, saving a respin.
(cid:127) Built a reusable verification environment that shortened bring-up on three subsequent blocks.
(cid:127) Automated regression on 40+ tests, freeing the team from weekly overnight runs.
(cid:127) Authored the internal style guide for verification coding still used today.
PUBLICATIONS AND PATENTS
(cid:127) Two conference papers on coverage closure methodology in mixed-signal designs.
(cid:127) One patent pending on an efficient stimulus generation scheme.
(cid:127) Reviewer for a workshop on verification methodology.

Bucharest. Romanian native, English C1, German B2.
A NOTE ON MY APPROACH
Verification is mostly about asking the design the uncomfortable question early, when it is still cheap. I have
spent a career learning that a schedule which assumes no bugs is not a plan, and that the coverage number
only means something if you can explain what it did not cover.
SELECTED PROJECTS
(cid:127) Mixed-signal SoC (2021 - 2023): verification lead for a block with analog and digital domains, with a UVM
environment built from scratch.
(cid:127) DDR controller (2017 - 2019): protocol verification across four speeds, with stress tests for read/write
latency.
(cid:127) Display pipeline (2014 - 2016): verification of a data path with strict timing, where a single missed
deadline dropped frames.
HOW I VERIFY
(cid:127) Model first: a reference model, even a simple one, catches more than clever scoreboards.
(cid:127) Constrained random: stimulus that reaches states a directed test would never visit.
(cid:127) Coverage with meaning: I look at what the holes are, not at the percentage.
(cid:127) Assertions: cheap checks that run always, next to checks that run only in simulation.
(cid:127) Bug discipline: a minimal reproducer, a root cause, and a regression that will stay.

(cid:127) I would rather disagree in a design review than discover the mismatch at tape-out.
(cid:127) I write specifications from the designer's point of view, not mine.
(cid:127) I ask for the corner case they think is impossible, because that is where the schedule dies.

Bucharest | [REDACTED_PHONE] | [REDACTED_EMAIL] | [REDACTED_URL]
PROFILE
Design verification engineer with 11 years in ASIC and SoC verification, mostly UVM and SystemVerilog on
advanced nodes. I have verified blocks that went to tape-out, and I have been the person who found the
corner case the schedule assumed was impossible. I care about coverage closure that means something, not
numbers on a slide, and I have a habit of writing reference models nobody asked for but everybody uses.
EXPERIENCE
Principal Verification Engineer 2019 - Present
Semiconductor company - Bucharest
(cid:127) Verification lead for a mixed-signal SoC block on a 7nm process.

Senior Verification Engineer 2016 - 2019
Fabless semiconductor - Bucharest

Verification Engineer 2013 - 2016
ASIC design house - Bucharest
(cid:127) Block-level verification, mostly directed and scoreboard based.

Design Engineer (internship) 2012 - 2013
Electronics manufacturer - Bucharest
(cid:127) Schematic capture and layout support for industrial control boards.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: SystemVerilog, UVM, C, Python (verification infrastructure)
Methodology: constrained-random, formal (basic), coverage closure, assertions
Tools: VCS, Questa, Verdi, Vmanager, Synopsys Design Compiler flow
Domain: DDR, SerDes, display pipeline, mixed-signal interfaces


SELECTED ACHIEVEMENTS
(cid:127) Caught a race condition in the arbitration logic before first silicon, saving a respin.
(cid:127) Built a reusable verification environment that shortened bring-up on three subsequent blocks.
(cid:127) Automated regression on 40+ tests, freeing the team from weekly overnight runs.
(cid:127) Authored the internal style guide for verification coding still used today.
PUBLICATIONS AND PATENTS
(cid:127) Two conference papers on coverage closure methodology in mixed-signal designs.
(cid:127) One patent pending on an efficient stimulus generation scheme.
(cid:127) Reviewer for a workshop on verification methodology.
EDUCATION
M.Sc. Electronic Engineering, Politehnica Bucharest. B.Sc. Electronics and Computer Science, University of
Bucharest. Romanian native, English C1, German B2.
A NOTE ON MY APPROACH
Verification is mostly about asking the design the uncomfortable question early, when it is still cheap. I have
spent a career learning that a schedule which assumes no bugs is not a plan, and that the coverage number
only means something if you can explain what it did not cover.
SELECTED PROJECTS
(cid:127) Mixed-signal SoC (2021 - 2023): verification lead for a block with analog and digital domains, with a UVM
environment built from scratch.
(cid:127) DDR controller (2017 - 2019): protocol verification across four speeds, with stress tests for read/write
latency.
(cid:127) Display pipeline (2014 - 2016): verification of a data path with strict timing, where a single missed
deadline dropped frames.
HOW I VERIFY
(cid:127) Model first: a reference model, even a simple one, catches more than clever scoreboards.
(cid:127) Constrained random: stimulus that reaches states a directed test would never visit.
(cid:127) Coverage with meaning: I look at what the holes are, not at the percentage.
(cid:127) Assertions: cheap checks that run always, next to checks that run only in simulation.
(cid:127) Bug discipline: a minimal reproducer, a root cause, and a regression that will stay.
MENTORING AND TEAM


(cid:127) I review the first block of every new verification engineer personally.
(cid:127) I run a weekly verification clinic where anyone can bring a puzzling failure.
(cid:127) I wrote the internal coding standard that the team still applies.
(cid:127) I introduced short design reviews before any environment is built, which saved weeks on the last project.
HOW I WORK WITH DESIGN
(cid:127) I would rather disagree in a design review than discover the mismatch at tape-out.

raw_cv.summary: DevSecOps engineer with 6 years making security part of the delivery pipeline instead of a gate at the end. I started in QA, which is where I learned that most security findings are really process problems. I have introduced SAST, secret scanning and dependency checks without slowing teams down, and I have the metrics to show it.

work_description: Integrated SAST, DAST and container scanning into CI pipelines.
Reduced critical findings reaching production by catching them at pull request.
Built a security champion programme across four engineering teams.
Maintained threat models for the payments services.
Automated regression for a large web platform.
Worked with security on penetration test remediation and retesting.
Manual and exploratory testing across client projects.

description: scanare SAST la fiecare pull request, cu praguri clare si exceptii documentate.
eliminarea cheilor din repository si rotatie centralizata.
sedinte de modelare cu echipele de plati, inainte de lansare.

items: Fac securitatea sa fie usoara de adoptat, altfel nu se foloseste.
Masur timpul pana la remediere si il urmaresc, nu doar numarul de gasiri.
Lucrez cu dezvoltatorii ca si cu un partener, nu ca un filtru de poarta.
Explic riscul in impact de business, pentru a obtine prioritate reala.

custom_sections.section_title: CE AM SCHIMBAT IN FELUL DE A GANDI
items: Am venit din QA, unde am vazut ca majoritatea incidentelor de securitate au fost procese lipsite, nu bug-uri de cod.
Munca la penetrare si cu echipe de dezvoltare m-a invatat ca avertismentele care nu sunt luate in considerare sunt exact cele care conteaza.
Am acceptat ca uneori solutia potrivita este un control de proces, nu un scanator in plus.
Nu am condus un program de bug bounty, desi am coordonat raportarea catre platformele de recompense.
Nu am lucrat cu investigatii de incident, doar cu preventie si raspuns.
Nu sunt pentester; ma concentrez pe partea de preventie si pe integrarea in dezvoltare.
Cred ca securitatea buna se vede in viteza echipei, nu in numarul de rapoarte. Daca oamenii fug de scanere, am esuat, chiar daca dashboardul arata bine.

custom_sections.section_title: CE INSEAMNA PENTRU MINE MUNCA IN SECURITATE
items: Un findings este mai putin valoros decat un control implementat si intretinut de echipa care va folosi efectiv tool-ul.
Masur timpul de remediere si adoptia, pentru ca ambele imi spun daca am facut bine munca.
Scriu documentatie pe care un alt om o poate intelege fara sa ma intrebe, pentru ca documentatia e singurul lucru care supravietuieste plecarii mele.

custom_sections.section_title: CE AS VREA SA SCHIMB IN INDUSTRY
items: Mai putine rapoarte si mai multe dovezi ca masura chiar e cea corecta.
Cultura in care riscul este spus devreme, nu ascuns pana la audit.
Sunt bine constienta ca sunt mai noua in rol si ca aceasta este o zona in care am de invatat.

custom_sections.section_title: UN EXEMPLU DE LA INCEPUT PANA LA FINAL
items: In 2022, un pipeline de livrare de software dintr-o platforma de retail procesa noapte intregi fara sa existe o verificare de vulnerabilitati. Am introdus scanarea la pull request, am mutat o parte din reguli in cod, si am ajuns la un prag acceptabil in cateva saptamani, cu un cost de timp de build de sub doua minute. Un an mai tarziu, un vulnerabilitate de dependenta a fost prinsa automat la prima revizie, iar asta a fost momentul in care echipa a acceptat complet masura.

consecinta.

nu mai exista.

Assess controls, test evidence and report findings to management.
Track remediation and advise on risk reduction.
Risk assessments and control testing.

items: Core banking audit: assessed change and access controls and drove remediation.

Third-party risk: reviewed key vendor controls and contracts.

I audit to improve, not to blame.
I explain risk in business terms, not just control jargon.
I follow up until findings are actually fixed.
I keep learning the technology so I can test what I audit.

ITGC, application controls and access management.
Cloud and database fundamentals for audit testing.
Risk frameworks and control libraries.

Build practical control libraries teams can reuse.
Coach teams to own risk instead of waiting for audit.
Keep technical skills current for real testing.
Report clearly to both management and engineers.

custom_sections.section_title: Ce Am Invatat Din Distant si Schimbari
items: In 2017 am lucrat aproape un an ca freelancer, in perioada in care si-au mutat o parte din productie in alta tara.
Am refuzat atunci o pozitie bine platita pentru a nu ma intoarce in aceeasi zona; a fost o decizie riscanta, dar a fost corecta.

Nu sunt un om de birou. Cand se strica ceva la ora 2 noaptea, eu sunt cel care merge acolo cu un laptop si o unelte, si asta este exact felul in care prefer sa lucrez. Vreau un mediu care isi asumeste seriozitatea productiei, nu unul care ascunde problemele in rapoarte.

(cid:127) Explic tehnicilor fara jargon, pentru ca intelegerea sa fie mai rapida decat interventia.

(cid:127) Tuvia pentru functii de siguranta, nivel SIL2 (2022).

este exact felul in care prefer sa lucrez. Vreau un mediu care isi asumeste seriozitatea productiei, nu unul care ascunde
problemele in rapoarte.

(cid:127) Invat acum mai mult despre analizele de risc si despreSIL, din cauza proiectelor in care standardele conteaza.
(cid:127) Vreau sa lucrez intr-o fabrica care considera automatizarea o investitie, nu o cheltuiala de mentenanta.

dar felul in care lumea merge dupa o interventie este singurul indicator care ma intereseaza.

In 2022, dupa o saptamani de opriri neprogramate pe una dintre liniile de imbuteliere, am gasit cauza intr-un senzor de

era in felul in care citim senzorul. Atunci am inteles ca documentatia senzorului si comportamentul lui in conditii reale
erau doua lucruri diferite, iar de atunci verific mai intai conditiile de mediu decat logica.

raw_cv.summary: Consultant cardiologist (medic primar) with 26 years in clinical and interventional cardiology, at Institutul Inimii, Cluj-Napoca. I perform coronary angiography and PCI (600+ procedures/year), run a heart-failure clinic, and coordinate the department's cath-lab on-call rota. I teach residents and believe the best cardiology is prevention done early and honestly explained.

work_description: Perform 600+ coronary angiographies/PCIs per year; lead a catheterisation room during STEMI calls.
Run the heart-failure clinic (350 patients under follow-up); reduced readmissions with structured follow-up.
Coordinate the cath-lab on-call rota; protocol lead for STEMI door-to-balloon under 60 minutes.
Clinical cardiology, echo lab and stress testing; started the interventional track.
Full residency including CCU rotations; logged 1,500+ in-patient cards.

engleza C1, franceza B2.


PROIECTE SELECTATE
(cid:127) Software pentru monitorizare (2021): aplicatie de configurare a dispozitivului, cu audit trail complet.
(cid:127) Migrare controler (2019): portarea algoritmilor de semnal de la C la C++ pentru performantn.
(cid:127) Documentatie de conformitate (2022): participare la dossier-ul tehnic pentru piata UE.
CUM LUCREZ
(cid:127) Scriu software in care se poate urmari fiecare decizie, pentru ca un audit sa nu fie o surpriza.
(cid:127) Treatez documentatia ca parte din produs, nu ca o corvoada de birou.
(cid:127) Verific si eu testele mele, pentru ca in mediu reglementat o greseala costa mai mult decat timpul pierdut.
(cid:127) Comunic transparent cu echipa de calitate despre riscurile pe care le vad.
CE A FOST MAI GREU
(cid:127) Ritmul reglementat nu se potriveste temperamentului meu, dar am invatat sa lucrez in el si chiar sa-l
folosesc ca avantaj.
(cid:127) In primul an am intalnit o neconcordanta intre cerinta si standard, si am inteles ca discutia trebuie sa fie pe
documente, nu verbal.
(cid:127) Am refuzat odata o lansare care nu avea trasabilitate completa; am fost perceputa ca prea stricta, dar
decizia s-a dovedit corecta.
CE MA MOTIVEAZA
(cid:127) Software-ul meu ajunge la pacienti si la asistenti care folosesc instrumente de diagnostic.
(cid:127) Gasesc satisfacnie in faptul ca nu poti face aproximatii intr-un domeniu reglementat.
(cid:127) Invat continuu, pentru ca domeniul se schimba si standardele se actualizeaza.
UN CUVANT DE FINAL
Am ales sa lucrez in mediu reglementat pentru ca aici consecintele se vad, iar asta da sens rigorului. Stiu ca
pot fi mai rapida si mai putin stricta in medii fara cerinte de conformitate, dar aleg sa lucrez unde standardul
chiar conteaza.
CUM ARATA UN PROIECT TIPIC
(cid:127) Analiza de risc, apoi cerinte, apoi proiectare documentata.
(cid:127) Dezvoltare cu revizii si trasabilitate completa a versiunilor.
(cid:127) Verificare si validare, apoi transfer in productie cu plan de monitorizare post-market.
CE MA BUCURA CEL MAI MULT
(cid:127) Faptul ca pot vedea rezultatul la un medic, la un pacient, chiar daca eu nu voi afla niciodata povestea
completa.
(cid:127) Standardele stricte, care ma-au facut sa fiu mai exacta decat as fi fost fara ele.


(cid:127) Echipa de reglementare si cei doi oameni care au tinut-o activa in perioadele grele.

raw_cv.summary: Data engineer cu 6 ani pe fluxuri de date in timp real si CDC, in Kafka si Debezium, cu warehouse pe dbt. Am pornit de la ETL clasic si am vazut ca lumea s-a mutat spre evenimente, asa ca am invatat Kafka mai devreme decat multi. Sunt obsedata de contracte de date si de idempotenta, pentru ca un pipeline care produce dublu nu se vede pana cand bilantul se strica.

work_description: Arhitectura fluxurilor CDC (Debezium, Kafka) catre warehouse.
Modelare dbt, teste de contract si monitorizare a calitatii datelor.
Reducerea latentei de la ingestie la tabelele analitice de la ore la minute.
Pipeline-uri batch si in timp real pentru evenimente de publicitate.
ManagementulWarehouse si costul stocarii in cloud.
Rapoarte si ETL; am inteles repede ca sursa de date conteaza mai mult decat dashboard-ul.

certifications: Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Kafka (2023).

projects.project_name: CDC pe baza de date operationala
description: Debezium si Kafka, cu latenta sub un minut de la scriere pana la tabelul analitic.
refacerea layerului de warehouse in dbt, cu teste de contract pe fiecare model.
politici de retennie si arhivare care au adus o scadere semnificativa a costului de stocare.
Am inlocuit un batch nocturn cu CDC pe baza de date operationala, iar rapoartele zilnice au devenit disponibile inainte de ora 8, nu a doua zi.
Am introdus teste de contracte pe modelele dbt, iar latenta a coborat sub un minut.

items: Incep cu contractul de date, pentru ca restul se construieste deasupra lui.
Testez pipeline-urile ca pe cod, cu date de asteptare si teste de contract.
Consider idempotenta o cerinta minima, nu o optimizare.
Explic datele si limitele lor celor care iau decizii, nu doar celor care scrie SQL.

custom_sections.section_title: CE AM SCHIMBAT IN FELUL DE A LUCRA
items: Am venit din BI si am invatat repede ca niciun dashboard bun nu salveaza o sursa de date gresita.
In 2022 am condus o migrare care a fost aproape un proiect de o luna; de atunci pun accent pe teste si rollback, nu pe rapiditate.
Am invatat sa comunic cu oameni din finance si sales care nu stiu ce inseamna un event log, fara sa simplific prea mult.
Nu am condus un cluster Kafka la scara foarte mare, am lucrat cu volumele obisnuite ale companiei.
Nu sunt inginer de platforma; partea de securitate si acces la datele mele o tratez cu seriozitate dar o las echipelor specializate.
Nu am construit data warehouse pentru un volum de ordinul zecilor de terabytes.

Daca as putea relua ceva, as cere mai devreme specificatii clare despre contractul datelor si as aloca mai mult timp pentru teste. Restul se recupereaza usor, o contractie grea se propaga in toate rapoartele de mai jos.
Am inlocuit un batch nocturn cu CDC pe baza de date operationala, iar rapoartele zilnice au devenit disponibile inainte de ora 8, nu a doua zi.
Am introdus teste de contracte pe modelele de dbt, iar latenta a coborat sub un minut.
Cel mai grav incident al meu a fost un pipeline care duplica randuri dintr-o repunere pe consumator; de atunci testez idempotenta in mod explicit.
Am constatat ca cele mai multe incidente veneau din schimbari de contract in upstream, nu din codul meu, si am adaugat monitorizare pe asta.

In 2022, am primit cererea de a construi un flux de evenimente care sa alimenteze, in timp real, tablour de bord pentru vanzari. Solutia clasica, un batch in fiecare noapte, ar fi fost suficient de simpla si complet inacceptabila pentru ca oamenii de vanzari au nevoie de cifrele de azi, nu de cele de ieri. Am folosit CDC si Kafka, am construit modelele dbt cu teste de contract, iar latenta a coborat sub un minut. Partea cea mai importanta a proiectului a fost insa definirea unui contract de date cu producatorii, pentru ca altfel fluxul ar fi fost rapid si gresit.
O data lipsa este mai costisitoare decat o data intarziata.
Un contract de date scris clar iti scade timpul de intreninere mai mult decat orice optimizare de cod.
Testele de contract prind probleme inainte de a deveni incident, si sunt cel mai bun randament pe care l-am gasit in cariera mea.
[CUM LUCREZ] Incep cu contractul de date, pentru ca restul se construieste deasupra lui.

inacceptabila pentru ca oamenii de vanzari au nevoie de cifrele de azi, nu de cele de ieri. Am folosit CDC si

fost rapid si gresit.

Own monitoring and drift alerts; caught a silent data-shift event that would have degraded accuracy.
Churn and next-best-action models; one production model saved an estimated EUR 1.4M/year.

raw_cv.summary: Site reliability engineer with 8 years keeping high-traffic systems up and calm during incidents. I define SLOs people actually respect, build observability that answers the right question, and run blameless post-mortems that reduce repeat failures. Currently at a fintech in Bucharest (payments, 4,000 rps peak), I lead the reliability guild and the on‑call programme.

work_description: Defined SLOs for 12 critical services; error budget policy adopted by all squads.
Cut pager fatigue 60% by replacing noisy alerts with symptom‑based ones tied to SLOs.
Ran chaos experiments (monthly game days) that surfaced 3 real single points of failure.
Lead incident response; MTTR down from 45 to 18 minutes over 18 months.
Ran Kubernetes clusters and CI/CD; introduced progressive delivery (canary + feature flags).
Fleets, monitoring, backups and night on‑call; wrote the first runbooks for the team.

description: Defined SLIs from logs and traces for 12 services; error‑budget policy turned reliability into a number teams could plan against.

Forecast traffic growth and rightsized node pools; 20% infra saving with headroom to spare for peak season.

raw_cv.summary: Technical product manager with 9 years (4 as engineer) building API and platform products. I sit between customers, engineers and business without being a bottleneck: I write clear specs, then get out of the way. Currently PM for a payments platform API at a Cluj company; my API roadmap is used by 300+ merchants and 4 internal teams.

work_description: Own the public API roadmap; grew developer adoption from 40 to 300+ merchants in 2 years.
Ran discovery with 30+ customers; killed 2 features before build and saved ~6 engineer-months.
Introduced API versioning and a deprecation policy; support tickets after releases -35%.
Owned the reporting module; drove usage from 12% to 44% of active accounts.
Backend engineer who kept asking why; moved to product with credibility from the code side.

description: Introduced versioning, a published deprecation window, and a changelog developers could actually find.
Support tickets after releases fell 35% and two large merchants cited API stability when they expanded their integrations.

items: Discovery before delivery: I talk to users monthly and bring evidence, not opinions, to prioritisation.
I write one-page specs (problem, users, outcome, constraints) and detailed API contracts.
Outcome-based OKRs over output; I track leading indicators, not feature counts.
API adoption: developer adoption grew from 40 to 300+ merchants in 2 years on the back of clearer docs and sandbox tooling.
Discovery saves: killed 2 planned features after customer interviews, saving roughly 6 engineer-months.
Internal platform: the shared API foundation cut new-service setup from weeks to days for 4 internal teams.
: VP Product and the platform engineering lead - on
request. GDPR consent given.
Availability: 45-day notice; Cluj hybrid or remote EU. References: VP Product and the platform engineering lead - on
request. GDPR consent given.

GDPR consent given.
